summary: Tango Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose initial safety and efficacy data from its Phase 1/2 combination trial of vopimetostat with Revolution Medicines' RAS(ON) inhibitors. The filing reports an ORR of 92% in PDAC patients and 100% in NSCLC patients. No M&A, activist, or special situation is involved; this is a routine clinical data disclosure under Regulation FD. The filing is a standard current report, not a special-situation event.
